reviewer.note: Review at 9366301b (main bytes), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md. Every stone is the same chamfered octagonal block in three flat planes (top, front, east), repeated at several sizes: no chips, cracks, cluster texture or mortar remnant, parts in three tones (checklist: flatness, repetition). Slates are flat blue bars with no lit edge or thickness. Fix: rubble from the cottage's own stone recipe: irregular lumps with a lit crown, body and dark underside in 4-5 tones and sibling clusters, broken faces showing mortar (stone_cool 0-1), a chipped corner each; slates with a lit top edge, a 1-2 px dark edge face and a break line. Compared with Eastward 17 rocks at x1.37; bar 0.79.
